big_case.notes: Significant commercial, consumer-finance, and bankruptcy-law case resolving a recurring circuit split over whether the Federal Arbitration Act applies to private automatic-stay damages claims under 11 U.S.C. § 362(k), affecting standard consumer credit agreements across consumer bankruptcies nationwide, though without major constitutional or political salience.
